name: Paper Lightbox
summary: A stack of cut-paper sheets in a shallow box lit from behind: moonlit blue layers, each one flat colour and each casting a soft shadow on the next, windows and lanterns burning through, titles on gold paper strips.

palette.use: the night sky at the top of the back panel; the box's dark
the burned-in subtitle line under the picture
auspicious clouds (the far layer); quiet subtitle words
the back panel's lowest, lightest step
window glow: warm light is the only saturated thing
seal red: the one accent, on seals only
the moon's halo and the backlight's colour
mid mountains with carved contour slits (0.45)
the moon's trail on the water
the near-black foreground bank and figures (0.05)
the warm interior ladder: the back wall
the warm ladder's front sheet; ink on the gold strips
the box's wooden frame in outside shots
the dark room around the box (falls to #0a0806)
lamp light spilling onto the table

type.case: sentence case on strips; spaced small caps for kickers
type.emphasis: a red seal beside the word, or a character lighting on its spoken word

banned: flat paper-cut without depth: every sheet is backlit and casts a soft shadow
a pale front layer: back layers bright and translucent, front layers dark and opaque
more than one flat colour on a sheet; gradients on sheets (only the lit back panel and light)
a second temperature in one stack (a new ladder means a new place)
squash, stretch, morphing or bending: paper slides, turns on a pivot, grows from an edge or lights up
a 3D diorama: every element is a flat sheet parallel to the front
whip pans, digital zooms, a drum kit
the same words as paper and as subtitle
half-visible box edges: fully out of frame or clearly in it
copying a specific lamp, film frame or character
